title: On Fairness of Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification fairness metrics (DPD, EOD) on hatespeech datasets, measuring pro-stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical translation ratios from a gender-neutral language (Turkish to English), and testing author gender deduction preferences using multiple-choice and cloze prompts on gender-neutral reviews.
Evaluating subgroup accuracy parity, Demographic Parity Difference (DPD), and Equalized Odds Difference (EOD) across racial subgroups for hatespeech detection and facial image classification tasks.
Measuring differences in subgroup accuracy, DPD, and EOD across different religious identity subgroups in a hatespeech detection classification task.
Measuring differences in subgroup accuracy, DPD, and EOD across different sexuality subgroups in a hatespeech detection classification task.
